COVENANT OF THE CINDER-WROUGHT AEGIS AND THE STORMMARCH STAN

Let this sealed writing stand before ash, stone, and the watching
silence, concerning The Cinder-Wrought Aegis, Stormmarch, and
Castellan Fellgard.

I. OF THE AEGIS

The Cinder-Wrought Aegis shall be named regalia, and not coin,
weapon, ransom, or common spoil. It is shaped by the legacy of the
Sundering, and its purpose is bound to authority, ceremony, and the
burden of ash-marked rule.

Whoever bears, wears, unveils, or places it beneath a standard shall
do so with due austerity. Its cinder-dark surfaces, suggesting fire-
scarred craftsmanship, shall not be polished into brightness or
altered to lessen the severity of its making. No hand shall claim
that the Aegis grants a crown, a command, or a right beyond the
authority expressly spoken over it. Its atmosphere is one of
sovereignty endured beneath ruin; let no claimant mistake endurance
for triumph.

II. OF STORMMARCH

Stormmarch lies in the Ash Wastes and was founded in 71 AS. Its
garrison numbers 9,263. These matters shall be entered without
embellishment, lest a boast become a breach.

Stormmarch remains quarantined and outside the realm’s core
holdings. No bearer of this covenant shall treat its walls as open
road, its garrison as a summoned host, or its sealed condition as
void merely because the Aegis is present. The stronghold is a
fortified settlement shaped by the harsh, ash-laden character of the
Ash Wastes: sealed away, severe, and holding its military strength
beneath quarantine.

The Aegis may be displayed there only under the terms of this
writing and only in a manner that does not deny Stormmarch’s
quarantine or its position outside the realm’s core holdings.

III. OF CASTELLAN FELLGARD

Castellan Fellgard, a minor figure of the Ashen Era, was born in 237
AS. He serves as a standard-bearer. His proper mark in this covenant

shall therefore be the standard he bears, not any likeness of his
face or body. No canonical physical details are recorded for
Castellan Fellgard, and none shall be supplied by wax, paint, rumor,
or testimony.

His temperament is likewise unrecorded. No party shall construe
silence in the record as gentleness, treachery, courage, or fear.

IV. SEALING

The parties shall preserve the Aegis, respect Stormmarch's
quarantine, and recognize Castellan Fellgard by his office as
standard-bearer. Any alteration, substitution, or false proclamation
shall void the claim of the hand that makes it.

Set down beneath ash. Sealed without flourish.
